items.title: Barclays downgrades Gartner, flags AI risks for information services stocks
items.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays downgraded Gartner (NYSE: IT) to Underweight while raising its price target to $185 from $150 in a note on Friday, as the bank remains cautious on information services companies whose business models could be disrupted by AI.

items.title: Employers added 165,000 jobs in October, soaring past expectations
items.summary: Hiring across the U.S. surged last month and unemployment dipped, a sign the job market is picking up speed.

items.title: Under Armour Revenue Falls on Broad Segment Declines
items.summary: Under Armour posted lower revenue in its fiscal second quarter, weighed down by a slump that cut across product categories and geographic segments.

items.title: Humana Lifts Outlook as Quarterly Revenue Jumps
items.summary: Humana raised its full-year earnings outlook as consolidated income and revenue rose in the recent quarter.

items.title: Sweetgreen Sees Milder Same-Store Sales Decline Following Rebound From Cyclospora Outbreak
items.summary: The salad chain’s third-quarter loss narrowed to $30.7 million as it bounced back from the Cyclospora outbreak, which triggered widespread consumer panic against leafy greens.

items.title: Cloudflare Stock Surges on Lifted Full-Year Outlook, Third-Quarter Revenue Growth
items.summary: The connectivity cloud company upped its projections for revenue this year to around $2.96 billion, above its earlier guidance for revenue between $2.86 billion and $2.87 billion.
